name: Minestrone
ingredients: 1 cup cooked kidney beans or cannellini beans
½ cup small pasta (ditalini or macaroni)
preparation: Heat olive oil, soften onion, garlic, carrot and celery 5 minutes.
Add zucchini, cabbage, tomatoes, beans, stock and oregano; simmer 15 minutes.
Add pasta and cook until tender, 8–10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, finish with basil.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
preparation: Heat oil, soften onion and garlic 4 minutes.
Add tomatoes, stock, sugar and salt; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend smooth with most of the basil; return to the pan.
Stir in cream and pepper, warm through, garnish with remaining basil.

name: Tuscan White Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 cups cooked cannellini or white beans
preparation: Heat oil, soften onion, garlic and carrot 5 minutes.
Add beans, stock and rosemary; simmer 15 minutes.
Mash a ladleful of beans against the pan to thicken.
Add greens, cook 3 minutes, finish with lemon juice, salt and pepper.

name: Pasta e Fagioli
ingredients: 2 cups cooked borlotti or kidney beans
preparation: Heat oil, soften onion, garlic, carrot and celery 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, beans, stock and oregano; simmer 15 minutes.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Season, serve with grated parmesan.

name: Zucchini and Basil Soup
preparation: Heat oil, soften onion and garlic 4 minutes.
Add zucchini and stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with basil until smooth; season.
Serve with parmesan on top.

name: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
preparation: Toast the bread slices until golden; rub each with the halved garlic clove.
Mix tomatoes, minced garlic, 2 tbsp olive oil, basil, balsamic, salt and pepper.
Spoon the tomato mix onto the toasts, drizzle remaining oil and serve at once.

name: Garlic Bread
preparation: Mix butter, garlic, parsley, oregano and salt.
Slice the bread, spread the garlic butter generously, top with mozzarella if using.
Bake at 200°C for 10–12 minutes until golden and crisp.

name: Caprese Skewers
preparation: Thread a tomato, a basil leaf and a mozzarella ball onto each skewer, twice.
Arrange on a platter, drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper and serve chilled.

name: Arancini (Cheese-stuffed Rice Balls)
ingredients: 3 cups cooked risotto or sticky rice (cooled)
preparation: Mix cooled rice with parmesan, parsley, salt and pepper.
Take a portion, press a mozzarella cube into the centre and shape into a ball.
Make a slurry of maida and water; dip each ball, then roll in breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry on medium heat until deep golden; drain and serve with marinara.

name: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 16 large button mushrooms (stems removed and chopped)
preparation: Sauté chopped stems and garlic in oil 3 minutes.
Mix with breadcrumbs, parmesan, ricotta, parsley, salt and pepper.
Fill mushroom caps generously.
Bake at 190°C for 18–20 minutes until golden.

name: Zucchini Fritti
ingredients: ¾ cup chilled sparkling water or plain water
preparation: Whisk maida, cornflour, oregano, salt, pepper and water into a thin batter.
Dip zucchini batons and deep-fry in batches until crisp and golden.
Drain, sprinkle salt, serve with lemon wedges.

name: Mozzarella Sticks
ingredients: 250 g mozzarella block (cut into thick sticks)
preparation: Mix breadcrumbs with oregano, garlic powder and salt.
Make a maida-water slurry; dip each stick, roll in breadcrumbs, then repeat for a double coat.
Freeze 30 minutes so the cheese holds.
Deep-fry on high heat 1–2 minutes until golden; serve with marinara.

name: Polenta Fries
preparation: Bring stock to a boil, whisk in polenta; cook stirring 20 minutes until thick.
Stir in parmesan, butter, rosemary, salt and pepper; spread 2 cm thick in a tray and chill until firm.
Cut into fries, brush with olive oil.
Bake at 220°C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp.

name: Margherita Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup marinara or crushed tomato sauce
preparation: Mix maida, yeast, sugar, salt, water and oil; knead 8 minutes into a smooth dough. Rest covered 1 hour until doubled.
Divide into two, roll thin.
Spread sauce, scatter mozzarella.
Bake at the oven's highest setting (250°C) 10–12 minutes until blistered; top with basil.

name: Mushroom and Olive Pizza
preparation: Make the dough as for Margherita and rest 1 hour.
Sauté mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil until dry.
Roll bases, spread sauce, add mozzarella, mushrooms, olives and oregano.
Bake at 250°C for 10–12 minutes.

name: Quattro Formaggi Pizza
preparation: Make the dough as for Margherita; rest 1 hour.
Roll bases, brush lightly with olive oil.
Scatter all four cheeses, sprinkle oregano.
Bake at 250°C for 10–12 minutes until bubbling.

name: Vegetable Lasagne
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic, zucchini, capsicum and mushrooms in oil 8 minutes; stir in marinara and oregano.
Make white sauce: melt butter, whisk in maida, add milk gradually, cook until thick; season with salt and nutmeg.
Layer sauce, lasagne sheets, vegetable sauce, white sauce and mozzarella; repeat three times, finishing with cheeses.
Bake covered at 180°C for 30 minutes, uncovered 15 minutes more. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
preparation: Mix spinach, ricotta, half the parmesan, garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Fill the tubes with the mixture (a piping bag helps).
Spread a layer of marinara in a dish, arrange tubes, cover with remaining sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake covered at 180°C for 30 minutes, uncovered 10 minutes.

name: Eggplant Parmigiana
preparation: Salt eggplant slices, rest 20 minutes, pat dry; dust in flour and pan-fry in oil until golden on both sides.
Layer marinara, eggplant, mozzarella, parmesan and basil in a dish; repeat, finishing with cheese and oregano.
Bake at 190°C for 30 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Rest 10 minutes, serve with bread.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add tomatoes, chickpeas, oregano, salt and pepper; cook 5 minutes.
Mix in rice, parsley and half the cheeses.
Fill the capsicums, top with remaining cheese.
Bake in a covered dish at 190°C for 30 minutes, uncover for the last 10.

name: Mushroom Ragù with Creamy Polenta
preparation: Bring stock to a boil, whisk in polenta; simmer stirring 20 minutes; finish with butter and parmesan.
Meanwhile sauté mushrooms in hot oil until browned; add onion and garlic, cook 4 minutes.
Add tomatoes, thyme, balsamic, salt and pepper; simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon ragù over the polenta and serve.

name: Zucchini Involtini
ingredients: 3 large zucchini (sliced lengthwise into thin ribbons)
preparation: Brush zucchini ribbons with oil and grill or pan-sear 1 minute each side until pliable.
Mix ricotta, parmesan, basil, garlic, lemon zest and salt.
Spread a spoonful on each ribbon, roll up, and set seam-down on a bed of marinara.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes.

name: Baked Ziti
preparation: Boil pasta 2 minutes short of packet time; drain.
Toss pasta with marinara, garlic, oregano, ricotta, half the mozzarella and olive oil.
Transfer to a dish, top with remaining mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until golden; finish with basil.

name: Spinach-stuffed Pasta Shells
preparation: Boil shells until just pliable; drain and cool.
Mix spinach, ricotta, parmesan, garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Fill shells, arrange on marinara in a dish, top with mozzarella.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.

name: Vegetable Calzone
ingredients: 1 cup sautéed mixed vegetables (mushroom, capsicum, spinach, onion)
preparation: Make pizza dough with maida, yeast, sugar, salt, water and 2 tbsp oil; rest 1 hour.
Divide into 4, roll into rounds.
Spread marinara on one half, add vegetables, cheeses and oregano; fold and crimp the edge.
Brush with oil, bake at 220°C for 18–20 minutes until golden.

name: Caprese-stuffed Portobello
preparation: Brush mushrooms with garlic oil, season, and roast gill-side up at 200°C for 10 minutes.
Top each with tomato and mozzarella slices.
Return to the oven 8 minutes until cheese melts.
Finish with basil and balsamic glaze.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
preparation: Cook spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Warm oil on low, cook garlic slowly until pale gold; add chilli flakes.
Toss drained pasta into the pan with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Finish with parsley and parmesan.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
preparation: Heat oil, cook garlic and chilli flakes 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, sugar and salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with al dente penne and a splash of pasta water.
Serve with parsley and parmesan.

name: Spaghetti al Pomodoro
preparation: Heat oil, soften garlic 1 minute; add tomatoes, sugar and salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti al dente; reserve pasta water.
Toss pasta in the sauce with a splash of pasta water; add torn basil.
Serve with parmesan.

name: Pasta Primavera
preparation: Cook pasta al dente; reserve ½ cup water.
Sauté garlic, then broccoli, zucchini, capsicum and peas 4 minutes; add tomatoes 1 minute.
Add cream, parmesan, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Toss pasta through with pasta water to loosen.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo
preparation: Cook fettuccine al dente; reserve ½ cup water.
Melt butter, soften garlic 1 minute, add cream and simmer 3 minutes.
Off heat, stir in parmesan, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Toss pasta through, loosening with pasta water; top with parsley.

name: Penne in Creamy Tomato Sauce
preparation: Soften onion and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, chilli flakes and salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and parmesan.
Toss with al dente penne and basil.

name: Pasta al Pesto
preparation: Blend basil, nuts, garlic, parmesan, oil, lemon juice and salt into pesto.
Boil pasta with potato and beans in the same pot until pasta is al dente.
Drain, reserving ½ cup water; toss with pesto, loosening with the water.
Serve with extra parmesan.

name: Pasta alla Norma
ingredients: ½ cup grated ricotta salata or parmesan (vegetarian rennet)
preparation: Salt the eggplant cubes 15 minutes, pat dry; fry in 3 tbsp oil until golden, set aside.
Cook garlic in remaining oil, add tomatoes, sugar and salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Add eggplant and basil to the sauce.
Toss with al dente pasta and top with cheese.

name: Mushroom Risotto
preparation: Sauté mushrooms in oil until browned; set aside.
Soften onion and garlic in 1 tbsp butter; add rice and toast 2 minutes.
Add lemon juice, then hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until rice is creamy and just tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms, remaining butter, parmesan, parsley, salt and pepper; rest 2 minutes.

name: Saffron Risotto (alla Milanese)
ingredients: a generous pinch of saffron (soaked in 2 tbsp warm vegetable stock)
preparation: Soften onion in 1 tbsp butter; add rice and toast 2 minutes.
Add lemon juice, then hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18–20 minutes.
Stir in the saffron liquid halfway through.
Finish with remaining butter, parmesan and salt; rest 2 minutes.

name: Pumpkin and Sage Risotto
preparation: Roast pumpkin with oil at 200°C for 20 minutes until soft.
Fry sage leaves in 1 tbsp butter until crisp; set aside.
Soften onion in the sage butter; add rice, toast 2 minutes; add stock a ladle at a time for 18–20 minutes.
Stir in pumpkin, remaining butter, parmesan, salt and pepper; top with crisp sage.

name: Gnocchi in Sage Butter
preparation: Mix warm riced potato with maida and salt into a soft dough; roll into ropes, cut into 2 cm pieces.
Boil in salted water until they float, about 2 minutes; drain.
Melt butter with sage until it turns nutty and the leaves crisp.
Toss gnocchi in the sage butter with parmesan and pepper.

name: Rosemary Focaccia
preparation: Mix maida, yeast, sugar, salt, water and 2 tbsp oil into a wet dough; rest covered 1 hour.
Spread in an oiled tray, dimple with fingers, rest 30 minutes.
Drizzle remaining oil, scatter rosemary and sea salt.
Bake at 220°C for 22–25 minutes until golden.

name: Garlic Knots
preparation: Make a pizza-style dough; rest 1 hour.
Cut into strips, tie each in a knot, rest 15 minutes.
Bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes.
Toss hot knots in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.

name: Grissini (Breadsticks)
preparation: Mix maida, yeast, sugar, salt, water and oil; knead and rest 1 hour.
Roll thin ropes, brush with oil, roll in sesame and rosemary.
Bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until crisp.

name: Marinara Sauce
preparation: Soften onion and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, oregano, sugar, salt and pepper; simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in basil. Keeps refrigerated 5 days; base for pizza, pasta and bakes.

name: Basil Pesto
preparation: Blend basil, nuts, garlic, parmesan and lemon juice, streaming in the oil.
Season; store under a film of oil in the fridge up to a week.

name: Caprese Salad
preparation: Alternate slices of tomato and mozzarella on a platter, tucking basil between.
Drizzle oil and balsamic, season, serve at room temperature.

name: Panzanella (Tuscan Bread Salad)
ingredients: 4 cups stale ciabatta or crusty bread (torn)
preparation: Toss bread in 3 tbsp oil and toast at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden.
Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion and basil; season.
Dress with oil and vinegar, add bread, rest 15 minutes so it soaks up the juices.

name: Panna Cotta (agar-set)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed berries or strawberry compote
preparation: Whisk agar-agar into the milk; add cream and sugar and bring to a boil, simmer 2 minutes stirring.
Off heat, add vanilla; pour into 4 moulds.
Chill 3 hours until set; unmould and serve with berries.

name: Eggless Tiramisu
ingredients: 24 sponge finger biscuits (egg-free) or plain sponge cake slices
preparation: Beat mascarpone with icing sugar and vanilla; fold in whipped cream.
Dip biscuits briefly in coffee and lay a layer in a dish.
Spread half the cream; repeat layers.
Chill 4 hours, dust with cocoa before serving.

name: Affogato
ingredients: 4 shots hot espresso (or ½ cup strong coffee)
preparation: Place a scoop of ice cream in each cup.
Pour a shot of hot espresso over it.
Top with shaved chocolate and serve immediately.

name: Chocolate Salami (no-bake)
ingredients: ½ cup chopped almonds and pistachios
preparation: Melt chocolate with butter, sugar and milk over a gentle heat; cool 5 minutes.
Stir in biscuits and nuts.
Shape into a log in baking paper, twist the ends, chill 4 hours.
Dust with icing sugar, slice into rounds.

name: Limonata (Italian Lemonade)
preparation: Simmer sugar and ½ cup water until dissolved; cool.
Mix syrup with lemon juice.
Pour over ice, top with sparkling water, garnish with mint and lemon slices.
